summary: Tropic City was a celebrated tropical cocktail bar at 672/65 Soi Charoen Krung 28, known for rum-focused drinks, fresh juices, music and a colorful interior. It permanently closed its Charoen Krung venue in April 2026, so it is not an option for a December 2026 visit.
whyGo: Historically, it was a destination for serious rum cocktails in a playful, tropical setting.
Its former Charoen Krung location sat in a lively district of bars, cafes and creative spaces.
bestFor: Travelers researching Bangkok's recent cocktail-bar history or planning a future visit if the team announces a new venue.
skipIf: You are planning a December 2026 night out: the bar and its former public opening hours are no longer operating.
duration: Not applicable for a visit; the former bar is closed.
cost: Not applicable. There are no public drinks prices or admission costs for December 2026 because the bar is closed.
hours: Permanently closed in April 2026. The operator's website gives no public opening hours for the former venue.
bestTime: Not applicable for a visit. The bar's former evening service does not apply after closure.
gettingThere: The former address was 672/65 Soi Charoen Krung 28, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500. Do not travel there expecting a public bar; the premises closed in April 2026.
booking: No public bookings are available for the closed bar. The operator's website mentions private events and consulting, but does not say that the former venue is open to the public or available for December visits.
accessibility: Not applicable as a public venue after closure. Accessibility details for the former premises were not established.
practicalTips: Treat older listings that show opening hours or booking links as outdated; confirm any future project through the operator's official site.
The operator has said it is focusing on hospitality consulting. No replacement public venue or reopening date was announced on the site when checked.
decemberNotes: Tropic City closed its Charoen Krung bar in April 2026, so it cannot be included as a December 2026 nightlife stop. No December public events or new venue were announced by the operator at the time of research.
uncertainties: The owners have described consulting and private event services, but the site does not specify future public bar plans or a replacement location.
Archived menus, prices, transport advice and access details may be outdated and are not useful for a December visit.
